author: RIP_Avicus
body: Would it be possible to implement a new rank of people who welcome players and make them feel at home? It would help if these people were friendly, approachable and could speak a few languages. Could this work? Opinions?
body_tagged: Would it be possible to implement a new rank of people who welcome players and make them feel at home? It would help if these people were friendly, approachable and could speak a few languages. Could this work? Opinions?
title: New Rank?

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
I don't really see the point.
We expect people to be friendly and approachable to new players anyway, I don't know why we would make a rank for it.
replies.body_tagged:

replies.author: Atdit
replies.body:
I think Avicus already has enough ranks, and more are making it just more difficult

More ranks = more complicated = less new members

(Atdit's math formula)

replies.author: Cynthesis
replies.body:
Thus, the Atdit Theorem came into existence :)

But in all seriousness, it doesn't seem very necessary, since that's an expectation to begin with. Giving a rank to someone that is only adhering a rule seems like a giveaway.

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
I think he means a translator rank.
Someone approachable, friendly = Needed for all staff members
Knowledge of a few languages could be a translator.

EDIT: 
But I would agree and say no.

The ratio of Staff/Members is 9/10. I would hate to see the day when it's above it. Most of the community = Staff members :'D

replies.author: Petlas
replies.body: Although I frankly agree with the others about there being too many ranks/the rank being unnecessary, it does spark a little note that the new folk are always a little petrified around staff members, donors, etc. Maybe something could be implemented to make them feel comfortable around each member? It could be something like an aim to greet as many new players with a 'Welcome' if they point out their newness in chat.
